profile.headline: Artist | Designer | Developer
profile.summary:
Art, Design, and Product Innovation, has been the driving force and focus my 30 years on this earth has so graciously provided for me. Something as mundane one might find in the overall process of development, I thrive in. Much of my creative abilities I give credit to the innate, however, learning from and becoming part of a group of similar functioning individuals solidifies my collaborative nature and has paved the way for such opportunities to learn from some of the greatest Artists and Designers and observing their strict branding guidelines, Two of the most notable being Disney/Pixar and King Features Syndicate. Learning the languages required to code user centered experiences, accessibility, and semantic digital products took my Object Oriented way of learning and gave me balance between the fold.

I have worked internationally with company owners, together among their design teams to lead the development of products both tangible and across a multitude of digital platforms. While overseas, my days, which often rolled into late nights, were spent designing and prototyping new product trends, desirable home and office decor, electrical circuits for components, and lighting. In a nutshell, I emerged from my endeavors from both my formal education and hands on experiences leading up to my understanding, drive, and dedication I must concurrently empower to achieve and maximize my goals while overcoming all obstacles.
I work well in both large groups or as an individual and adapt well to new faces and places.
I took the past three years to focus on product development for the web and to become acclimated with the current W3C and other working group specifications, catching up on the new web APIs and building new tools to adapt to my workflow. Currently building upon the CSS level 4 working draft, New Webkit JavaScript functionality, and Redesigning/Thinking my additive printing solution, mark 6, which will have major improvements of it's schematics and resolution.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Main objective: Share insights and knowledge with those who need a creative outlet. The use of information architecture analogously with a well formed digital structure ensures smooth interconnectivity among all of those involved. Working prototypes are standard combined with future-proof training for anyone whom had been involved.

positions.title: Lead Developer • Founder
positions.locationName: San Diego, California • London, United Kingdom
positions.description:
Main objective: Help build the future of 3D printing, and remain actively present in its rapidly growing community. A healthy amount of communication during the development process while combining resources will ensure our products will hold true to future working drafts with hopes on become a major asset to the 3D printing community.

3Dep.com, pronounced 'Three Deep', Stands for Three-Dimensional Electronic Printing and began as a side project first proposed by R.M. Miller Jr. in San Diego California, later collaboration with interested parties lead to positive growth in Europe, primarily in the U.K. We look forward to having those involved become part of our growing social base and making the most of what 3D printing, modeling, and the creative arts industry has to offer.

positions.title: Direct Importer • Product Designer
positions.description: Dynasty Products is a direct imports company that specializes in antique reproductions. I worked with overseas manufactures and designers while researching trends for future product development. While at the company I successfully launched two design campaigns which focused on home decor and compact storage solutions and small scale models incorporating transportation vehicles which were designed to be hand formed and manufactured from thin yet sturdy aluminum sheet metal.
